title: Technical Field Manual — choose the composition
question: The visual direction is selected. Choose the composition to build, or add a note about what to combine or revise. All three keep the same emerald identity and verified content.

options.label: Profile + project
options.thesis: Your technical focus and a real project share the opening equally.
options.viewport: Large identity on the left; an emerald project flow on the right; credentials underneath.
options.risk: The large diagram makes the opening denser than the other options.

options.label: Profile first
options.thesis: Introduce the person, then open a broad project exhibit.
options.viewport: Identity and portrait across the top; a wide project flow below; credentials at the foot.
options.risk: The project has less vertical room for technical detail.

options.label: Project first
options.thesis: Lead with the work and keep your professional context alongside it.
options.viewport: The project occupies the broad left field; the identity and portrait sit in a compact right column.
options.risk: Recruiters encounter the project before the full personal introduction.
